name: How do I choose the right contractor for structural framing repairs and wall removal?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for structural framing repairs and wall removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: To select a qualified framing contractor, look for a licensed, insured general contractor who directly manages structural carpentry rather than completely subbing it out. Confirm they have a strong track record, such as an A+ BBB rating, and ask specifically how they handle temporary shoring, engineered beam calculations, and building inspections. A qualified contractor acts as a hands-on lead, coordinates licensed plumbing and electrical sub-trades when lines sit inside the wall, and provides clear communication from demo through drywall finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a licensed contractor with strong ratings who manages structural carpentry directly, understands shoring procedures, and coordinates necessary trade permits.
